messages:
ellie: Quick sync  Polaris Dataworks signed off to be a customer story. Interview set Mon 5/23 10:30am PT. Need legal quote approval, who records, assets, and lead routing for post-publish demo CTAs. Calendly: <https://calendly.example/polaris-interview>

omar: I can run recording + upload. Prefer Zoom cloud + local audio. Will do a 10-min tech check at 10:15.

jess: Draft quote (please edit):
```
"Polaris moved to Redwood Dedicated and cut inference cost per request by ~67% while stabilizing p95 latency by ~52%, enabling faster feature velocity."
```

paul: CS/ops: I'll validate the ~67% and ~52% numbers with infra and post confirmation. If they're estimates we should prefix with ~ or round.

anya: Design needs headshots (400x400 min), transparent logo (svg/png), and any product screenshots. Need assets by Fri EOD to make thumbnails + a 30s social cut.

cory: Legal: any specific numbers require written attestation from Polaris legal before publish. Also avoid product claims tied to safety/health. Send final quote and attestation here and I'll review.

ellie: Who owns pull quotes and blog draft?

jess: I'll draft three pull-quote lengths and the blog once CS confirms numbers.

omar: Recording checklist: 1) Zoom cloud recording + local audio; 2) Capture slides as PDF; 3) Otter.ai transcript; 4) Save raw + trimmed to /marketing/assets/polaris/raw/; 5) create captions SRT.

paul: I'll post verified numbers by Thu midday.

anya: For launch plan  blog + social reel (30s) + webinar mention. SDR ops: route inbound demo signups to queue=west-sdr and tag campaign=polaris_q2. Include UTMs.

ellie: @paul please confirm numbers and attach customer attestation by Thu so legal can sign off same day.

cory: Once attestation is in, I'll post legal sign-off here.

jess: Timeline quick: Thu midday  numbers + attestation; Fri EOD  assets in folder; Mon 10:15am  tech check; Mon 10:30am  recording; Fri next week  publish blog + social + demo CTA.

omar: I'll schedule the tech check and rehearsal, and upload raw files after recording.

ellie: Thanks team  I'll add launch checklist to #launches and coordinate PR timing once legal approves. :rocket:
